Vicar of St.

Paul’s, Haggerston, contributor to MP (1865-84)

He was vicar from 1874 of St Paul’s, Haggerston, and author of the famous Tractarian hymn 'The Church's One Foundation'. [Clergy List 1887; ODNB]
